prompt: Which months of 2025 had an average order value below 315 euros? A month's average order value is its total net_revenue_eur divided by its number of different orders. Use the sales table and its order_month column, the first day of the month the order was placed in, and count only order lines dated from 1 January 2025 to 31 December 2025, both days included. Every order counts, including an order whose lines all have a missing net_revenue_eur, and a missing net_revenue_eur adds nothing to the total. Return three columns, in this order: order_month, n_orders, the number of different orders, and avg_order_value_eur, that average order value. Return one row per month, and only the months whose average order value is below 315, sorted by order_month from earliest to latest. Do not round.
hints: Next, keep the 2025 lines, group them by month, and write the group filter on the average order value.

An order has several lines, so divide the revenue total by the number of different orders, not by the lines. That division is about a whole month, so the test on it comes after GROUP BY. Sort the months in date order.
why_this_works: Dividing each month's revenue by its different orders gives the order value, HAVING keeps the months below 315, and ORDER BY puts them in date order.
